paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Accuracy comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage.
model_annotation: This line plot compares the accuracy of two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, during the Embedding and LM Head training stage, with accuracy measured as the probability of correctly predicting the next token. The x-axis represents the training step, ranging from 0 to 60000 on a linear scale, labeled “Step”. The y-axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.10 to 0.40 on a linear scale, labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)”. The plot displays two lines: the blue line with circular markers represents “Ex1 Accuracy”, which starts at approximately 0.24 at step 0, rises sharply to about 0.395 by step 10000, and then plateaus near 0.40 from step 20000 to 60000. The cyan line with circular markers represents “Ex2 Accuracy”, which begins at 0.10 at step 0, increases to about 0.28 by step 10000, rises further to approximately 0.365 by step 20000, and then stabilizes near 0.385 from step 30000 to 60000.
